subject: Fox passing through
alt: A red fox pauses mid-stride on the sunlit paved path, tail held straight behind, one ear cocked back toward the grass.

subject: Lone cobbled cap
alt: A single pale mushroom with a rounded, cobbled white cap stands on a tall stalk at the mossy foot of a furrowed trunk.

subject: Buck in velvet
alt: A young buck with antlers still in velvet stands broadside in a sunlit lawn, watching the camera from the shade line.

subject: Cat off duty
alt: The grey cat sleeps stretched full-length along a weathered wooden step, one forepaw dangling over the edge.

subject: The lit path
alt: Evening sun pours through the trees onto the paved path where it curves past a rock-lined creek bed edged with daylilies.

subject: Doe gone wading
alt: A doe stands shin-deep in the shaded creek beside a tangle of flood-washed branches, pausing with her head turned upstream.

subject: The colony returns
alt: Dense clumps of shaggy, scale-freckled white caps crowd shoulder to shoulder out of the dark rot of the old log.

subject: Sun through ears
alt: A cottontail sits up alert in the evening grass, the low sun glowing orange through its upright ears.

subject: Squirrel and rabbit
alt: A fox squirrel crouches in a patch of sun while a rabbit grazes behind it at the shaded fence line.

subject: Shelves like stairs
alt: Cream shelf fungus with ruffled amber edges juts out in tiers up a leaning trunk, like stair treads below the broken snag.

subject: Two in clover
alt: Two cottontails sit apart along a bank of blooming clover, one down among the blossoms and the other up at the edge of the paved path.

subject: Rabbit in bloom
alt: A rabbit sits chest-deep in blooming white clover with one ear up and the other folded flat.

subject: Young rabbit, watching
alt: A young cottontail crouches on smooth river stones at the garden's edge, dark eye level with the camera.

subject: Buck at rest
alt: A velvet-antlered buck lies folded in the grass against a wall of tall summer growth, ears turned to the camera.

subject: Owl at dusk
alt: A barred owl perches on a bare branch against the violet evening sky, round face turned straight down toward the lens.

subject: The young owl
alt: A fluffy young owl grips a wide, dark limb high in the canopy, staring down with black eyes.

subject: Mallard pair resting
alt: A mallard drake and hen rest in the grass at the edge of a pond, the dark water behind them speckled with floating seed fluff.

subject: Thumb-high tan caps
place: old leaves at the wood’s edge
alt: Three small tan mushrooms with striated bell caps push out of dark leaf litter, lit from behind by out-of-focus orange leaves.

subject: Shaggy white colony
alt: Dozens of shaggy white oval caps crowd along both sides of a fallen branch on a rotting log, ringed by wet green undergrowth.

subject: Same colony, closer
alt: A mass of shaggy, scale-flecked white mushrooms in every size pushes up around a bare fallen branch lying across decayed wood.

subject: One cream cap
place: mowed grass by the rock bed
alt: A single cream-colored mushroom with a flattened, faintly cracked cap stands in mowed grass in front of a strip of river-rock landscaping.

subject: Two rain-flecked caps
place: a lawn on the backside of a hill
alt: Two pale mushrooms with upturned, rain-flecked caps rise from a patch of lawn at the bottom of a gentle slope that made a great home for this colony.

subject: Broad twin caps
alt: Two broad cream caps, their edges just touching, spread over dark grass with a blurred tree trunk and walking path behind them.

subject: White buttons leaning
alt: Two rounded white caps tinged tan at their crowns nestle side by side in deep green grass, one leaning against the other.

subject: Golden shelf fungus
alt: Ruffled golden shelf fungus sprouts at three heights up a deeply furrowed tree trunk, backlit by green canopy and a scrap of blue sky.

subject: Cluster with company
alt: A cluster of flat tan mushrooms sits in wet clover-studded grass while a loose line of white-stemmed caps recedes up the slope behind.

subject: Three after rain
alt: Three cream mushrooms with wavy, rain-spotted caps stand at different heights in glistening grass and clover.

subject: Cap under leaf
alt: A small white mushroom shelters beneath a fallen green leaf that rests on its cap like an awning, among twigs and dry stems.

subject: Pale shelf fungus
alt: Pale yellow shelf fungus fans out from the base of a leaning trunk in a stand of trees, above a floor of knee-high undergrowth.

subject: Mallards out walking
place: wet grass by the rail fence
alt: A mallard drake and hen walk through tall wet grass beside a leaf-scattered asphalt path, with a low wooden rail fence behind.

subject: Pleated pink caps
place: the lawn’s edge by the iris bed
alt: Half a dozen delicate pinkish-tan mushrooms with pleated caps stand in mown grass at the edge of a mulched bed of iris leaves.

subject: Coin-sized grey cap
alt: A single small grey-white mushroom hides low in a tangle of thick wet lawn grass, a blade bending across its cap.

subject: Cat on patrol
alt: A grey cat with amber eyes sits among rain-soaked leaves and deadfall, looking back over its shoulder at the camera.

subject: Pink button cap
alt: A pink-tinged button mushroom on a slender stalk stands in wet grass beside a long yellow leaf caught in the blades.

subject: Two unhurried deer
alt: Two white-tailed deer pause on spring grass beside a curving paved trail, the nearer one facing the camera with ears spread wide.
